fields.value: Additional file 16: of Surface PEGylation suppresses pulmonary effects of CuO in allergen-induced lung inflammation

dsDescriptionValue.value: Figure S12. Number of DEGs and canonical pathways involved in the inflammatory response to CuO materials in PBS-challenged and OVA-challenged mice. A differential expression analysis was performed in which each experimental group was compared against their corresponding negative controls. Thereafter, the activation z-scores of the pathways obtained from IPA were compared in PBS-challenged and OVA-challenged mice. A, A table of DEG numbers specific to PBS- and OVA-challenged groups, and an overlap between them (number of common DEGs). B, A heatmap of (in)activation of predicted canonical pathways with IPA cut-offs of absolute z-score > 2 and -log(P value) > 2. (TIF 1300 kb)
